name: @red-cup-engineering/resonator
description: The Ashlar fiber's audio/music engine: a parameterized synthesis core (voices as data, node-testable and WebAudio-renderable from the same params), a seeded/scale-aware/intensity-driven procedural music layer rendered as event streams, and a game-audio kit (preset banks, mixing/ducking, reduced-audio mode, volume persistence) on top. The DSP core was ported from @red-cup-engineering/music-engineering-services-section (Red Cup's ambient-render engine) and has since evolved independently; the generative core is consumed directly as a dependency on that same package rather than forked. See README for the absorption note.

scripts.check: for f in $(find src scripts -name '*.mjs' 2>/dev/null); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; echo 'all .mjs files parse cleanly'
